name: Body Snatchers Guild
source:
A young man has to convince the horny neet who took over his Guild master's body to actually go out and do adventure-er stuff.

[From [url=https://waywardvoidgod.itch.io/body-snatchers-guild]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
